=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1010-1044 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The extracted ANNOUNCE_EDIT_REGEX is very long and hard to safely maintain, and a future syntax error would silently make the stuck-intent grep fail open.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the regex is difficult to audit/modify and that a malformed alternation would be treated like “no match,” degrading diagnostic fidelity.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1291 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The stderr check can run in an unintended path when codex_delta is empty, even if stdout had content and only the worktree delta ended up empty.
  WHY: This causes an unnecessary extra grep on stderr in that edge case, which the reviewer judged to be minor overhead rather than a correctness bug.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1291, 1326 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new stderr greps scan entire per-attempt log files without any size limit or early termination guard.
  WHY: The reviewer warned that long-running attempts can grow logs enough to make repeated full-file scans add measurable wall-clock overhead.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1010-1044 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The regex uses multiple alternations in a way that can trigger catastrophic backtracking on partial matches in long logs.
  WHY: The reviewer observed that this could materially slow grep on large codex_log_attempt_N.txt files and risk retry-loop timeouts.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1220-1260 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The cmd_rc==0 empty-delta branch scans the full log even though the delta check has already established the attempt is empty.
  WHY: The reviewer characterized this as unnecessary repeated work that adds small per-attempt overhead across retries.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
